status: Adopted by Ahimanikya on 13 November 2026; implementation in progress; website not yet published
scope: AI assistance and authorship for poetry submissions

sources.finding: FAQ distinguishes permitted grammar/spelling from prohibited generative composition
Rejects generated/heavily modified work; requests declaration
Indexed primary page says human-written works and no generative AI editorial practice; direct open403; editorial practice not suitable for wholesale adoption
2023 study on English essays reports detector false positives and bias; not validation for Odia/Hindi poetry

recommended_policy.eligible: Human-authored poetry; mechanical proofreading, accessibility/transcription/transliteration and disclosed critique without retained generated poetic expression
recommended_policy.ineligible: Generated poetic lines/stanzas or substantial AI replacement of expressive language, imagery or voice, even after surface human editing
recommended_policy.translation: Separate derivative; rights-holder permission, source credit, fluent human review and explicit final proof approval; consent does not reactivate removed website translations
recommended_policy.production: Human-accountable AI-assisted art/editorial production explained in Our Story; same source-poem authorship protection applies to editorial changes
recommended_policy.fairness: No detector-only refusals, style-based accusations or missing-draft presumptions; clarification and second human review available; no undisclosed external detector uploads
recommended_policy.disclosure: Work-specific multi-select assistance declarations; separate translation fields; explanation, policy version/time/source revision; private immutable declarations with amendments and separate editor decision
recommended_policy.legacy: Prospective; old missing declarations unknown, not no-AI
recommended_policy.placement: Propose explicit narrow allowance for AI intake questions and policy link; production narrative remains Our Story

review: Independent agent review completed; distinctions and translation-publication restriction incorporated; not human editorial approval
implementation: No website, database, runtime, messaging or publication changes
adoption: Looks good; let’s adopt this policy and implement the submission form, database, and author profile improvements we discussed.
